headline: Australian Market Extends Early Losses In Mid-market
summary: The Australian market extended its early losses in mid-session trade on Thursday, snapping a three-session winning streak. The move came despite broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight.
why: The S&P/ASX 200 is Australia's benchmark equity index, and its direction reflects the performance of the country's largest listed companies.
why_moved: The index extended early losses and snapped a three-session winning streak, despite positive overnight cues from Wall Street.
